description.summary: which workspace (realm) a desktop group belongs to

protocol.description:
The compositor keeps one set of desktops per Kora workspace, and announces every one of them through ext_workspace_v1 as its own group. Nothing there says which workspace a group belongs to; this protocol does, so a switcher can lay desktops out under the workspace that owns them.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

interface.name: kora_workspace_realm_manager_v1
interface.description: Binding this global announces the workspace of every desktop group the client can see, and of every group announced afterwards.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Informs the server that the client will no longer use this global.

event.name: realm

description.summary: the workspace a group belongs to

event.description: The desktops in `group` belong to the Kora workspace `id`, the same identifier the workspace registry uses. Sent once per group, after the group itself has been announced.
